title: Form Largest Integer With Digits That Add Up To Target
description: Find the largest integer string formed by digits 1-9 that sum to a target value, using provided costs for each digit.
pseudocode:
1. dp = Array(target + 1).fill('')
2. for cost in 1..9:
3.   for i in cost..target:
4.     if i == cost or dp[i - cost] != '':
5.       candidate = digit + dp[i - cost]
6.       if candidate.length >= dp[i].length:
7.         dp[i] = max(dp[i], candidate)

steps.note: Initialize DP table for target 5. Index 0 is empty string base case.
Processing digit '2' (cost 2). Compare lengths for index 5: '11111' vs '2111'.
Final DP table after considering all digits. Optimal value at index 5 is returned.
